screen.survivalcreativitymod.hide_breaks: Hide blocks to mine — show only blocks you need to place

screen.survivalcreativitymod.blocks_empt: No block changes in this hologram.

screen.survivalcreativitymod.controls_hi: Only affects the imagination — restored when you exit
message.survivalcreativitymod.edit_enter: Real creative imagination. Nearby chunks are copied first; builds farther out are still tracked. K saves a hologram of the diff, I exits and restores the world.

Local imagination. Nearby chunks are copied first; builds farther out are still tracked. World stays live; builds are client-only. Chat still works. You look AFK on the server. K saves a hologram, I exits and clears local edits.
message.survivalcreativitymod.edit_exist: Editing "%s" in real creative. K saves over it, I exits and restores the world.
Editing "%s" locally. K saves over it, I exits and clears local edits.
message.survivalcreativitymod.edit_exit: Imagination ended — world restored to how it was.
message.survivalcreativitymod.load_hint: Press H, then click an imagination to show its hologram.
message.survivalcreativitymod.empty: Nothing to save — change some blocks or entities first.
message.survivalcreativitymod.exit_edit_: Exit imagination edit (I) before loading a hologram.
message.survivalcreativitymod.preview_st: Hologram: %s — fill it in survival. Press U to hide.
message.survivalcreativitymod.recovery_r: Restored survival state after an interrupted imagination session (inventory, position, and world edits). Check H for an auto-saved "Disconnected" build.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_add_: Save this imagination — you must be near the build
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_sent: Shared imagination "%s". Other players with the mod can click [Add] near the build.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_empt: Nothing to share — this imagination has no block changes.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_busy: Already sharing an imagination — wait for it to finish.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_larg: [SurvivalCreativity] Large hologram "%s" — server-side mod required to receive this share.
Shared large imagination "%s" via the server. Others with the mod can click [Add] near the build.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_need: Large shares need this mod installed on the server (or LAN host).
This hologram is too large for chat share (%s parts, max %s). Install the mod on the server to share large builds.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_enco: Failed to encode imagination for sharing.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_deco: Failed to read a shared imagination from chat.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_expi: That shared imagination is no longer available.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_too_: Too far from the imagined build — go to %s, %s, %s then click [Add] again.
Too far from the imagined build at %s, %s, %s (you are ~%s blocks away). Walk closer, then click [Add] again.
message.survivalcreativitymod.share_chun: Chunks at the imagined build (%s, %s, %s) are not loaded yet. Move closer, then click [Add] again.
